title: Penthouse de luxo na Praia da Rocha

Com áreas generosas e uma disposição funcional, esta penthouse oferece o máximo conforto e elegância.

Exclusive Penthouse in Praia da Rocha - Panorama Building

Discover this unique penthouse located on the 15th floor of the emblematic Panorama Building, in Praia da Rocha and being just 300 meters from the beach.

The building underwent a painting and repair intervention on the facades in 2026, giving it a renewed, modern and cared for image.

With generous areas and a functional layout, this penthouse offers maximum comfort and elegance.

- Fully equipped modern kitchen

- Office with natural light

- Social bathroom with shower
